title: Resolved-cylinder PINN
caption: The field network and a trainable angular velocity are constrained by Navier–Stokes, continuity, hard no-slip and zero torque. FEM-generated velocity data assist training. Published spin values are used only in the final comparison.

title: Couette flow
caption: CO01: fields in the frame moving at ΔU/2. Cylinder center y/H=0.5 is prescribed. PINN uses internally generated FEM velocity anchors; the relative velocity L2 error on independent points is 0.168%. Article values are held out.

title: Equilibrium rotation
caption: Direct comparison with the supplied finest-grid article table at Rep=1 and 2. Lines connect two evaluated conditions; they are not a continuous Reynolds sweep. No parameter was tuned to either article spin value.

title: Rotation plateau
caption: The blue curve is digitized from supplied Figure 2(b). FEM/PINN predict only the steady angular speed, shown over the final reference window t=20–30. They do not predict or validate the preceding transient relaxation. The numerical table is the primary target.

title: Benchmark geometry
caption: Original walls (0, ΔU) are transformed by a Galilean velocity ΔU/2. The cylinder translates with the symmetry-plane fluid velocity and rotates freely. Its symmetry-plane position is an input, not a validated prediction.

title: Free rotation
caption: Kinematic rendering of the PINN-predicted steady rotation. It does not show simulated startup, acceleration or lateral migration.
